description: Builds your vocabulary deck from your actual life — your job, your hobbies — with spaced repetition.
notes: Spaced-repetition is a simplified SM-2; deck content is seeded demo data.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: Words tied to your nursing shifts stick better than generic lists — true, and every SRS app since 2008 knows it. $5/mo for personal decks competes with Anki (free) and every LLM that generates example sentences on demand. There's no business here, just a feature.
